---
title: "Écologie Chimique — BSc S5"
---

Course materials for **Chemical Ecology**, BSc S5, University of Neuchâtel.
Taught by Prof. Pengjuan Zu.

## Lectures

- [**Week 1 — Introduction to Chemical Ecology**](lectures/week01-history-of-chemical-ecology/index.qmd)
  A ~30-minute interactive history of pheromone discovery, plant defense signaling,
  and floral deception, with built-in discussion pauses.

- [**Week 2 — Infochemicals**](lectures/week02-infochemicals/index.qmd)

- [**Week 3 — Plant-Herbivore Interactions**](lectures/week03-plant-herbivore-interactions/index.qmd)
  The Great French Wine Blight, plant direct resistance (physical, chemical,
  constitutive, induced) and tolerance, and how herbivores counter it.

- [**Week 4 — Tritrophic Interactions**](lectures/week04-tritrophic-interactions/index.qmd)
  The cassava mealybug and Hans Rudolf Herren, natural enemy guilds, how
  plants recruit them (reward vs. HIPV), and the HIPV discovery story.

*(Add new weeks here as the course grows — see `README.md` for the workflow.)*
